metadata.title: Commercial spyware & phone-forensics vendors: Paragon, QuaDream, Circles, Variston, Cognyte + the extraction industry (Cellebrite/GrayKey)
metadata.frame: Batch 4 of the threat-actor catalog: the commercial surveillance INDUSTRY beyond NSO/Gamma/Intellexa. Two adjacent-but-distinct markets: (1) REMOTE spyware (zero-click implants) - Paragon, QuaDream, Circles, Variston, Cognyte; and (2) PHONE-FORENSICS EXTRACTION (physical-access unlocking of seized devices) - Cellebrite, GrayKey/Magnet, MSAB. The distinction matters: remote spyware infects targets covertly; extraction tools crack devices in custody.
metadata.grade: Vendor existence, products, ownership, and exposure/sanctions actions = FACT (Citizen Lab; Google TAG; Meta; company filings; US Entity List/Treasury). Specific TARGETING findings (who a client spied on) are Citizen Lab/Google forensics - well-corroborated but from parties, graded. Extraction-tool 'customers' (police, FBI) are documented via procurement + case records.
metadata.honest_limits: Extraction vendors (Cellebrite, GrayKey) sell LAWFUL-access tools to law enforcement - dual-use, documented in abuse cases but categorically different from covert remote spyware; this block keeps them on a separate sub-hub. 'Ethical spyware' is vendor framing (Paragon) that documented targeting contradicts. Ownership chains (Francisco Partners, AE Industrial) are as-reported.
metadata.method: Citizen Lab (Circles 2020; QuaDream 2023; Paragon/Graphite 2025); Google TAG (Variston 2022-23); Meta 'surveillance-for-hire' report (2021, named Cognyte/Cobwebs/BellTroX); US Commerce Entity List + Treasury; Cellebrite/Magnet filings + procurement records.

edges.notes: Paragon Solutions (Israel) sells 'Graphite' zero-click spyware, marketed as the 'ethical' alternative (democracies only). Citizen Lab (2025) documented Graphite targeting journalists/activists via WhatsApp in Italy - contradicting the framing (fact of product; targeting per Citizen Lab, graded).
Citizen Lab's 2025 Graphite findings (Italy 'Paragate') forced an Italian government inquiry - the pattern of forensics -> political fallout repeating (fact of report).

Paragon was acquired by US-based AE Industrial Partners (Florida, ~2024) and secured a ~$2M ICE/HSI contract (2024) that was paused under White House review - the 'US-friendly spyware' play (fact; contract status evolving).
QuaDream (Israel) sold 'Reign' - an iOS zero-click rival to Pegasus; exposed by Citizen Lab + Microsoft (2023), it shut down shortly after (fact).
Citizen Lab mapped QuaDream servers across 10+ countries and documented iOS victims - a case where exposure directly preceded a vendor's collapse (fact).

Circles (SS7-based phone-location + call/text interception, no infection needed) was commonly owned with NSO under the Q Cyber / Francisco Partners era; Citizen Lab (2020) identified 25 government customers (fact).
Citizen Lab's 2020 Circles report exposed the SS7-interception market - a telecom-signaling attack class distinct from device implants (fact).

Variston IT (Spain) built the 'Heliconia' exploitation framework (Chrome/Firefox/Windows n-days); exposed by Google TAG (2022-23) and reportedly wound down ~2024 - the EU-based exploit-broker branch (fact).

Cognyte (Israel; ex-Verint) was named in Meta's 2021 'surveillance-for-hire' report (alongside Cobwebs, Black Cube, BellTroX) for fake-account reconnaissance + targeting - the 'social-media surveillance' vendor tier (fact).
Meta removed Cognyte-linked accounts and reported it publicly (2021) - platform action against surveillance-for-hire, complementing the Apple/Meta NSO suits (fact).

Cellebrite (Israel; Sun Corp-backed; NASDAQ: CLBT) makes UFED - the dominant seized-phone EXTRACTION tool used by police/agencies worldwide (the San Bernardino iPhone debate; also documented in authoritarian misuse). Physical-access forensics, NOT remote infection (fact; distinction kept).
GrayKey (Grayshift, merged with Magnet Forensics 2023) unlocks/extracts modern iPhones for law enforcement - the US-centric rival to Cellebrite (fact).

Extraction tools are procured heavily by US federal + local law enforcement (FBI, ICE/HSI, police) - lawful-access technology whose oversight/misuse is the live civil-liberties debate (fact; oversight contested).

Adjacent industry: both sell government surveillance capability, but extraction (physical/consented-custody) is legally + technically distinct from covert remote spyware - flagged to avoid conflation (interpretation/taxonomy).

Like NSO, Gamma-successors, Paragon, QuaDream, Cognyte and Circles, much of the industry clusters in Israel (Unit 8200 alumni pipeline) - the geographic concentration of the surveillance-tech sector (fact/context).
Anchors the COMMERCIAL-SURVEILLANCE branch of the lineage (privatized offensive capability sold to states) - distinct from state APTs, criminal ransomware, and hacktivism (fact of category).
